persons.name: Trivikrameśādaṭa
persons.evidence: coya dhunakāvaṃ lānihma vāsinā śrītri(30r6)vikrameśādaṭa puṣṭakam iti

date.as_written: saṃ 804 phālguṇa śikla pakṣe navamyāntithau śukravāra

notes: The name 'śrītrivikrameśādaṭa' is likely corrupt (possibly Trivikramadatta or Trivikrameṇa ... pustakam). The rest of the passage is a dhyāna of Gaṅgā from the Rudrayāmala followed by Newari notes on iconographic details.
